description: This file contains an integration test class 'IpTrackingIntegrationTest' for the Apache Fineract platform. It tests the IP address tracking feature when creating a client, verifying that the IP address is correctly recorded during the client creation process.

classes.name: IpTrackingIntegrationTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for verifying IP address tracking during client creation in the Fineract platform. It sets up REST-assured specifications, creates a client, and checks that the IP address recorded matches the expected localhost IP.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST-assured settings, builds request and response specifications, and initializes the audit helper before each test.

methods.name: capturesIpAddressWhenCreatingClient
methods.description: Test method that enables IP tracking, creates a new client, retrieves audit logs, and asserts that the IP address recorded matches the expected local IP.
